闯入者！注意：

我们是扎娜姆的守护者。你们在[From.GetName]星系的存在是对我们造物主的羞辱。我们的程序驱使我们将你们摧毁。化作尘埃成为广阔宇宙的一部分吧。
excerpt.en:
INTERLOPER! Heed this message:

We are the Guardians of Zanaam. Your presence in the [From.GetName] system is an affront to our Creators. Our programming compels us to destroy you. Make your peace with the universe.

summary.text:
# 扎娜姆守护者 / Guardians of Zanaam

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/galactic_features_events.txt:11-70`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:909`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

首次进入标记了 guardians_of_zanaam 的星系，且守卫尚未被消灭（全局旗标 guardians_zanaam_destroyed）时（on_entering_system_first_time）。

Entering for the first time a system flagged guardians_of_zanaam while the guardians are not yet destroyed (global flag guardians_zanaam_destroyed) (on_entering_system_first_time).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单窗口警告：与扎纳姆之子（派系 zanaam_country）建立通讯，选项“进入红色警戒”。

A single warning window: communications with the Zanaam faction (zanaam_country) are established; option "Go to red alert!".

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

无。

None.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。

None.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

守卫被摧毁后 galactic_features.3 设全局旗标（不在本清单）。

After the guardians are destroyed galactic_features.3 sets the global flag (not in this list).
